thread:
noor: Quick review of the compact console dark theme. Two fast issues: sparklines lose visibility against the inner panel shadow and the tiny heatmap squares are problematic for folks with red-green deficiencies. Dropping a compact palette plus an accessibility toggle idea.

blee: can you paste the vars so i can try in storybook?

noor: sure — short list: `--bg:#0d0f11; --panel:#121416; --muted:#99a2aa; --brand:#63c9ff; --spark:rgba(99,201,255,0.6); --heat-low:#47b7a9; --heat-mid:#ffdf82; --heat-high:#ff6f58`

mae: spark alpha 0.6 still fades in inset panels. bump to 0.9 or add a 1px outer glow on hover. For heatmap, low/med are too similar under protanopia. Suggest switching low to a cooler desaturated teal and keeping med as yellow. Also add an optional hatch overlay for 'Accessibility: heatmap patterns'.

arne: legend in compact layout is eating vertical space. Can we collapse into a small legend icon that expands on hover/focus? keyboard users need a clear 3:1 focus ring when it's interactive.

noor: summary plan:
- sparkline opacity -> 0.9 + subtle hover glow
- heatmap: low -> #3fb2a3, mid -> #ffd77d, high -> #ff6f58; optional hatch overlay when accessibility toggle enabled
- collapse legend into hover/focus expandable icon in compact layouts with accessible focus outlines
- update small-label sizes/weights to pass 4.5:1 contrast where required

blee: copy tweak for settings: change "Color-blind mode" to "Accessibility: Heatmap patterns" and tooltip: "Improves readability for color-vision differences." avoids othering phrasing.

mae: please add a Storybook fixture + Figma frame so QA can toggle patterns. design-bot: can you upload the frame?

design-bot: Frame uploaded: https://figma.com/file/zxy-compact-nocturne-heatmap (noor/compact-heatmap-pass)

noor: thanks — I'll open a small PR with CSS variables + storybook fixture and ping QA for automated contrast checks. :white_check_mark:
